description: Look up the FORUM trust record for one MCP server listed in the official MCP Registry. Returns, in one response: the ed25519-signed record (sub-scores for provenance, static scan, drift and incidents; a derived band; evidence pointers; a null score with a stated reason wherever coverage is missing), the record's Merkle proof, and a paragraph of verify instructions. record_json is byte-identical to the body of GET /v1/trust/{registry_name} on the FORUM HTTP API; record_content_sha256 is the record hash and Merkle leaf. Records are rebuilt daily; as_of_input_date is the input date of this one. An unknown name returns isError with error=not_in_registry: the name is not in the current registry snapshot, which is absence of a record, not a negative finding. What a score is NOT: Not a security guarantee, not a penetration test, not certification of code correctness. It is a longitudinal behavioral-reputation summary with full evidence disclosure: scanners answer "is this safe to install today"; FORUM answers "what has this thing done since everyone installed it". Verify, do not trust: recompute the hash, check the signature, and check the proof against a root obtained independently. Read-only.

registry_name.description: MCP Registry server name, exactly as the registry spells it: owner/name, e.g. io.github.pipeworx-io/19hz. Contains a slash; pass it raw (no URL-encoding). Case-sensitive.

name: trust_lookup
title: FORUM trust record lookup
